# X to Group

From X. For your group. A private reading space for X posts and long-form articles, curated by people and translated and organized with AI.

- [Agent installation contract](/agent-install.md)
- [English documentation](/docs/en/start)
- [中文使用文档](/docs/zh/start)
- [Installation targets](/docs/en/deploy)
- [Personal iPhone shortcuts](/docs/en/shortcut)
- [AI providers and credentials](/docs/en/models)
- [X sources and groups](/docs/en/sources)
- [Feishu wiki setup](/docs/en/feishu)

Choose local Node.js + SQLite, Cloudflare Workers + D1, or Docker + SQLite + Caddy on a private server. Read AGENTS.md before changing a checkout. Preserve existing data and encryption keys. Each member has their own submission token. Private content requires login or a personal MCP credential.
